transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor! I’ve been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father’s orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away! Explain yourself!

The mead barrels may have met an untimely end during a celebratory feast in your absence. As for your rune-map, I regret to inform you that it may have gotten caught in the midst of our jovialities.

It seems my attempts to maintain order in the hall were not as successful as I had hoped. The scorch marks on the walls are a result of a few... enthusiastic demonstrations of my lightning prowess. I take full responsibility for the chaos that has unfolded in your absence.

However, fear not, my friend. I shall assist you in restoring order to the hall and help you with your rune-map. Consider it my penance for the mess that has been made. Let us work together to set things right, for Asgard and for our own honor.

And scorch marks from your so-called displays of power? Brother, enough with the excuses!

Your idea of "help" and "penance" better not involve more destruction. I shouldn't have to corral a storm of chaos each time I leave. So tell me, dear Thor, how do you propose we begin mending the colossal mess you've unleashed?
